name: CodeForge MCP
description: A self-hosted MCP server that provides a single execute_code tool, enabling agents to write TypeScript to call multiple REST APIs via fetch() with transparent credential injection, reducing token usage by keeping intermediate results in the sandbox.

rawRecord.description: A self-hosted MCP server that provides a single execute_code tool, enabling agents to write TypeScript to call multiple REST APIs via fetch() with transparent credential injection, reducing token usage by keeping intermediate results in the sandbox.

YOLO_MODE.description: Set to true to remove Deno domain allowlist, allowing sandboxed code to reach any internet destination. Default: false.

DEBUG_MODE.description: Set to true to enable debug logging of full request/response payloads.

USER_AGENT.description: Value to overwrite the User-Agent header on outbound requests.

REDACTING_STRINGS.description: Comma-separated list of strings to redact from outbound requests.
